import Base

def Life.lag(
  k: Nat, total: Nat, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  List.take(&2, U32,
    List.append(&2, U32, List.replicate(U32, k, 0), cells), total)

def Life.lead(+k: Nat, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  List.append(&2, U32,
    List.drop(&2, U32, cells, k), List.replicate(U32, k, 0))

def Life.rule(
  cells: List<&2, U32>, +width: U32, +i: U32,
  nw: List<&2, U32>, n: List<&2, U32>, ne: List<&2, U32>,
  w: List<&2, U32>, e: List<&2, U32>,
  sw: List<&2, U32>, s: List<&2, U32>, se: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case cell <> rest:
      match nw n ne w e sw s se:
        case nw0 <> nws n0 <> ns ne0 <> nes w0 <> ws e0 <> es sw0 <> sws s0 <> ss se0 <> ses:
          +x = U32.mod(i, width)
          +west = Bool.to_u32(U32.is_ne(x, 0))
          +east = Bool.to_u32(U32.is_lt(U32.inc(x), width))
          +near = (
            nw0 * west + n0 + ne0 * east +
            w0  * west      + e0  * east +
            sw0 * west + s0 + se0 * east
            : U32)
          Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(
            U32.is_eq(near, 3),
            Bool.and(U32.is_eq(cell, 1), U32.is_eq(near, 2))))
            <> Life.rule(rest, width, U32.inc(i),
              nws, ns, nes, ws, es, sws, ss, ses)
        case _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _:
          Nil{}

def step(
  +width: U32, height: U32, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +span = U32.to_nat(width)
  +total = U32.to_nat((width * height : U32))

  nw = Life.lag(1n+span, total, cells)
  n  = Life.lag(span, total, cells)
  ne = Life.lag(Nat.sub(span, 1n), total, cells)

  w = Life.lag(1n, total, cells)
  e = Life.lead(1n, cells)

  sw = Life.lead(Nat.sub(span, 1n), cells)
  s  = Life.lead(span, cells)
  se = Life.lead(1n+span, cells)

  Life.rule(cells, width, 0, nw, n, ne, w, e, sw, s, se)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+more:
      evolve(more, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
